description: Configuration class for a Spring Batch job that updates deposit account maturity details in the Fineract system. Defines beans for the job, step, and tasklet involved in processing deposit accounts.

classes.name: UpdateDepositsAccountMaturityDetailsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up batch job, step, and tasklet for updating deposit account maturity details.

methods.name: updateDepositsAccountMaturityDetailsStep
methods.description: Creates the batch step for executing the deposit account maturity details update, using the specified tasklet.

methods.name: updateDepositsAccountMaturityDetailsJob
methods.description: Creates the batch job that orchestrates the step, with an incrementer for unique run instances.

methods.name: updateDepositsAccountMaturityDetailsTasklet
methods.description: Provides the tasklet bean responsible for performing the actual account maturity details update.
